defects.quote: Jo needs an "Add partners" field on the booking
defects.description: The Problem names the solution (an "Add partners" field on the booking form) instead of only describing Jo's situation.

defects.quote: - THEN both are added and the booking shows its 4 partners
defects.description: The Two at once scenario accepts additions that take the booking to 4 partners, while its rule allows at most 3 and refuses any addition that would take it past 3.

defects.quote: WHEN a partner removes themselves from a booking, the system SHALL take their name off it and
defects.description: Leave a booking lets a partner remove themselves, but Only the holder changes partners says the system refuses any member who does not hold the booking trying to remove a partner; both cannot hold.
